ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with GER 465, CRN 58484, sec CW. "Topic: Study Abroad and Second Language Acquisition" "This course is designed to increase students? knowledge of research on the role that study abroad plays in language acquisition and to allow students to explore possible areas of future research. The course will focus on the following themes: structure and administration of study abroad programs; comparisons of classroom and study abroad learning; study abroad and language skills; study abroad and cultural knowledge; and the social dimensions of study abroad. The course will be taught in English and will incorporate research on several host countries/target languages."
